scenarios.title: A Case becomes solved at the beginning of its controller's end step if its condition holds

setup.notes: Case of the Locked Hothouse is unsolved. To solve: you control seven or more lands.

decisions: Both players pass priority in main2; the end step begins.
If the To-solve trigger fired, both players pass and it resolves.

variants.label: seven_lands
variants.expected: At the beginning of A's end step the condition holds: the To-solve trigger fires and the Case becomes solved.

variants.label: six_lands
variants.delta: A controls six Forests instead of seven.
variants.expected: The condition does not hold: the To-solve trigger does not fire and the Case stays unsolved.

variants.label: opponents_end_step
variants.delta: It is B's turn (B is the active player) and the step is B's end step; A controls seven Forests.
variants.expected: The trigger is for its controller's end step only: it does not fire and the Case stays unsolved.

scenarios.title: A solved Case stays solved until it leaves the battlefield

setup.notes: Case of the Gorgon's Kiss is already solved: a 4/4 Gorgon creature with deathtouch and lifelink in addition to its other types. No creature cards were put into graveyards this turn.

decisions: Both players pass priority in main2; the end step begins and ends; the To-solve trigger does not fire for a solved Case.

variants.label: stays_on_battlefield
variants.expected: The Case is still solved after the end step although its condition is false: still a 4/4 Gorgon creature with deathtouch and lifelink.

variants.label: leaves_and_returns
variants.delta: Before the end step A casts Unsummon (tapping Island) targeting the Case, then casts the Case again (tapping Swamp) and it resolves; its enters trigger has no target.
variants.expected: The new Case is not solved and is a noncreature enchantment; the condition is false at the end step, so it stays unsolved.

scenarios.title: The solved designation is not copied

setup.notes: The original Case of the Uneaten Feast is already solved.

decisions: A casts Copy Enchantment, paying {2}{U} with three Islands; it resolves and enters as a copy of Case of the Uneaten Feast.
A checks whether the Solved ability (Sacrifice this Case: creature cards in your graveyard gain "You may cast this card from your graveyard" until end of turn) can be activated.

variants.label: copy_activation
variants.expected: The copy is not solved: activating its Solved ability is not legal.

variants.label: original_activation
variants.delta: A checks the original Case's Solved ability instead of the copy's.
variants.expected: The original is solved: activating its Solved ability is legal.

scenarios.title: A solved Case's static Solved ability applies only while it is solved

setup.notes: Case of the Gateway Express: Solved - creatures you control get +1/+0. Already solved in the base.

decisions: No actions; the board is observed.

scenarios.title: A solved Case's triggered Solved ability triggers only while it is solved

setup.notes: Case of the Ransacked Lab: Solved - whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, draw a card. Already solved in the base. Its cost reduction only reduces generic mana, so Lightning Bolt still costs {R}.

decisions: A casts Lightning Bolt targeting B, tapping Mountain.
If the Case triggered, its trigger resolves first (both players pass).
Both players pass; Lightning Bolt resolves.

variants.label: solved
variants.expected: The Case triggers on the cast and A draws a card. Lightning Bolt deals 3 damage to B (17 life).

variants.label: unsolved
variants.expected: The Case does not trigger and A draws no card. Lightning Bolt deals 3 damage to B (17 life).

scenarios.title: A solved Case's activated Solved ability can be activated only while it is solved

setup.notes: Case of the Uneaten Feast: Solved - Sacrifice this Case: creature cards in your graveyard gain "You may cast this card from your graveyard" until end of turn. Already solved in the base.

decisions: A checks whether the Solved ability (sacrificing the Case) can be activated.

variants.label: unsolved
variants.expected: Activating the ability is not legal.
